note: Both sets contain exactly the same 25 claims with identical values, units, conditions and quotes; the only difference is the ordering of the HSS4XX6X1/4 member claim within the list. Both capture the section designations (W8X10, W10X12, W6X20, HSS4X4X1/4, HSS4X6X1/4, PL3"X1/4", L3x3x1/4", L4X4X5/16, C3X6, C8X11.5), the T.O. STEEL 11'-4" and SOLAR ENVELOPE 18'-0" elevations with their conditions, and the drawing scales tied to the correct elevations. Both repeat 2'-4" and 9'-0" as separate claims and use generic 'dimension | value' entities, but these flaws are shared. Since the content is identical, neither set is better.
remarks: The two sets are content-identical apart from claim ordering. Both leave out the FIRST FLR 2'-4" and GRADE LEVEL 0" datums as distinct named elevations (2'-4" appears only as an unlabeled dimension), and both use generic 'dimension | value' entities that don't say which member or elevation a dimension belongs to.
